summary.headline: Milanese Codices 29–33
summary.text: Catalog entries 29–33 of the Milanese codices, describing sixteenth-century manuscripts and their astrological contents: Empedocles’ spheres of the fixed stars and planets, earthquake treatises by Hermes Trismegistus and Orpheus, palm-line prognostication, and omens from air, parhelia, the Moon, celestial phenomena, lightning, and thunder.
